normalization: mean bias / largest absolute model mean bias per benchmark
zero_scale: All zero biases map to zero
weighting: Spherical cell area from native bounds
mask: Saved basin grid-centre mask; average over valid cells only
caveat: Custom relative mean-bias score, not ILAMB skill. Spatial errors can still cancel within a regional mean.
et_score: Mean of MODIS and GLEAM ET benchmark scores
lai_score: Mean of MODIS and AVH15C1 LAI benchmark scores
gpp_score: Mean of FLUXCOM and WECANN GPP benchmark scores
biomass_change_score: ESACCI6.0 biomass-change score from the separate GCP_270926a4BE run
aggregate_score: Equal-weight mean of all six comparison benchmarks and ESACCI6.0 biomass change; category scores are reported as within-variable means
